name: Knife Server
description: A small local server for the bnk command-line workbench.
longdescription: Keeps Binary Ninja available to the bnk command-line client, including in headless and container workflows.

installinstructions.Darwin: Link or copy this directory into ~/Library/Application Support/Binary Ninja/plugins/knife_server.
installinstructions.Linux: Link or copy this directory into ~/.binaryninja/plugins/knife_server.
installinstructions.Windows: Link or copy this directory into %APPDATA%\Binary Ninja\plugins\knife_server.

author: binja-knife contributors
